headline: OpenAI says its Codex and ChatGPT Work agents together now have 40 million weekly users.
score_reason: Pool 6, lowered 1: the headline credits the 40 million to the business agent alone; the figure covers Codex and ChatGPT Work.
importance_line: It shows how many people now hand tasks to OpenAI's agents, but the 40 million figure is OpenAI's own and the article's other numbers do not match it.
summary: Maeil Business Newspaper reports that Thibaut Sotio, head of product at OpenAI, said on 7 Oct 2026 that Codex, the coding agent, and ChatGPT Work, the general task agent, together had 40 million weekly active users, an all-time high. According to OpenAI, about 20 percent of Codex users were non-developers in June, a group the paper says grew more than three times faster than developers.
notes: Full article read. Publisher is the Korean daily (mk.co.kr).
